notes: Local Lighthouse 13.6.0. All seven routes on mobile and desktop; first full sweep used one run per combination.
First homepage mobile score 83 failed the performance threshold; repeat used the unchanged standard three-run median policy: 82, 94, 93 => 93. No source changes between these audits.
Preview intentionally noindex; raw SEO score 69 is retained. Production fixture checks verify indexable behaviour separately.
Raw reports retained in deliverables/lighthouse-immersive/current and .local/lighthouse-immersive-home/current. CI runs three audits for every route/device.
Wide-source experiment failed the mobile gate (87,84,83; median84). It is retained for comparison and was not shipped.
Final native portrait crop passed unchanged thresholds: mobile95,83,93 (median93); desktop99,99,99. Raw reports retained in .local/lighthouse-immersive-home-portrait/current.
